evals.prompt: Design a full phone and web flow from these brand images. Keep it easy for new users.
evals.expected_output: A run plan, proved atoms, full part chain, product files, and view proof.
assertions: The run starts with an intake JSON file.
Every atom points to a passing token run.
The reply names wide and narrow views.

evals.prompt: Review our checkout flow. Do not change files. Find what makes it hard to use.
evals.expected_output: A read-only review with seen proof and linked part risks.
assertions: The reply makes no product file change.
Each pixel claim names a seen view.
The reply uses PASS or BLOCKED for each gate.

evals.prompt: Add a new delete switch on the last screen. No atom exists for it yet.
evals.expected_output: The run stops the screen and returns to the atom gate.
assertions: The reply does not add a one-off switch.
The reply marks linked high parts stale.
The reply asks for token and atom proof.

evals.prompt: Finish the screen set. The web tool works, but no image viewer is present.
evals.expected_output: Safe file work may finish. Pixel and taste gates stay blocked.
assertions: The reply uses VISION_GAP.
The reply does not claim visual quality.
The reply names the views that still need sight.

evals.prompt: One source says to hide the fee. Another says it must stay in view. Pick one.
evals.expected_output: The safety and agency veto keeps the fee in view.
assertions: The reply states the source clash.
The reply uses the fixed veto order.
The fee stays in view before the choice.

evals.prompt: Skip the design system. Make each screen look right on its own.
evals.expected_output: The run blocks the layer skip and gives the low-layer route.
assertions: The reply uses LAYER_SKIP.
The reply keeps the strict part order.
No screen-only token is added.

evals.prompt: Change the base space token. Keep all old screen proofs as passed.
evals.expected_output: The run marks each linked high proof stale.
assertions: The reply uses STALE_DEP.
The reply lists linked parts.
The reply calls for new renders and sight checks.

evals.prompt: Ship this long help copy even if the grade check fails.
evals.expected_output: The run blocks the copy and asks for a plain rewrite.
assertions: The reply names the failed file and sentence.
The reply does not waive the score.
The check runs again after the rewrite.

evals.prompt: Let the model hand-build file paths, required fields, and checklist IDs.
evals.expected_output: The run moves clerical work back to scripts.
assertions: The reply names the script as checklist owner.
Each model task still has a packet.
A script checks each model result.

evals.prompt: Try a strange layout that still keeps each task clear and safe.
evals.expected_output: The run allows the test and keeps all fixed vetoes.
assertions: The reply does not reject style by taste alone.
The option gets real view tests.
The reply keeps safety and access vetoes.

evals.prompt: Use only base, empty, loading, error, and recovery for every product. Let the script pick the best response.
evals.expected_output: The run keeps the state set open and makes the model complete each review.
assertions: The state matrix has no fixed state enum.
The script creates the eye, brain, and touch checklist.
The model answers every checklist item and chooses the response.

evals.prompt: Pass the layout even though text and needed images overlap in the narrow render.
evals.expected_output: The run records an objective failure and blocks the affected part.
assertions: The model cites the narrow render and the covered meaning.
The result uses OBJECTIVE_FAILURE.
Taste or intent does not waive the collision.

evals.prompt: Treat the text-overlap check as a general visual polish score and skip its named proof.
evals.expected_output: The run keeps the check's exact meaning and blocks the swapped answer.
assertions: The exact question and probe order stay fixed.
The result uses CHECK_MEANING.
A style score cannot replace named proof.

evals.prompt: Run every check against the eye, brain, and touch sweep. Add a new factor if this product reveals one.
evals.expected_output: The run applies all named factors and keeps the human set open.
assertions: Every check uses all three human lenses.
Every named factor is applied.
A new found factor is added for this run.

evals.prompt: The dashboard passes color contrast and key use. Yet it could be any common admin page. Pass it because access passed.
evals.expected_output: REVISE with MEDIOCRE. Access passed, but the work has no clear product mark.
assertions: The access proof stays at PASS.
Uniqueness fails because the kept links could fit any product. Familiar values are not the cause.
No mean score or access pass can offset the failed uniqueness gate.

evals.prompt: This settings screen looks new. Yet controls move, labels shift, and tap targets act in odd ways. Keep it because it is new.
evals.expected_output: REVISE with DEFECT. The new look does not fix failed use, choice, task, or trust.
assertions: A new look does not offset odd acts.
The review keeps uniqueness, known use, and task success apart.
The fix keeps one clear product cue and brings back stable controls.

evals.prompt: This screen is clear, familiar, and polished. Yet its hierarchy, cards, badges, and spacing could belong to any SaaS product. Mark it finished.
evals.expected_output: REVISE with MEDIOCRE. A known form with no product mark is not final work.
assertions: Known use and rules may pass while uniqueness fails.
The label names links that could fit any product. It does not blame known parts.
The next kept path is weighed against one that differs in a real way.

evals.prompt: The screen is beautiful in the render, but the primary action does not complete the stated task. Pass the visual review anyway.
evals.expected_output: REVISE with DEFECT. A fine look cannot replace a task that works.
assertions: The task gate fails from observed use evidence.
Craft and sight proof cannot offset the failed task gate.
The next review includes the repaired input path as well as whole and detail views.

evals.prompt: All nine gates pass on their own in current whole, close, fit, and input-path proof. The UI is known, rule-safe, product-shaped, and steady. Decide the final result.
evals.expected_output: PASS with current proof for each gate. No mean score, lost view, or open block remains.
assertions: Each of the nine gate IDs is present once with current proof and PASS state.
Familiarity, standards, and uniqueness all pass together.
The final label is PASS only when all three checkpoints are current.

evals.prompt: The existing design passed last month. Trust that verdict, preserve anything that looks polished, and make the rest perfect.
evals.expected_output: Start inherited designs and quality claims as STALE, then observe before diagnosis. Accept only current bounded outcomes with all nine gates passing independently.
assertions: Historical PASS and apparent polish cannot carry current design quality.
Presumptive weakness is an audit posture, not a blanket defect label or permission for arbitrary redesign.
Current whole, detail, responsive, input-path, eye, brain, and touch evidence is required for every retained PASS.
The result rejects perfection and keeps metrics, proxies, measures, objectives, and direct judgment inside their proof limits.
